cards.title: Nvidia Pauses Chip Shipments to Southeast Asia
cards.body: Nvidia has instructed manufacturing partners to halt server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia. The move aligns with U.S. efforts to prevent AI chips from reaching China.

cards.title: GTA VI Launch Proves Human Creativity Wins
cards.body: Grand Theft Auto VI became one of entertainment's most successful launches on the same day Anthropic went public. The painstakingly human-made game demonstrates the enduring value of craftsmanship over pure efficiency.

cards.title: S&P Eyes Nvidia Credit Downgrade Over Governance
cards.body: The credit rating agency is considering lowering Nvidia's rating to AA- over governance and 'key man' risks. The downgrade would reflect concerns about leadership concentration and corporate oversight.

cards.title: OpenAI Merges Chat and Work With New Limits
cards.body: OpenAI is combining ChatGPT's Chat and Work experiences under a single usage meter. Heavy users may hit usage limits sooner under the unified system.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Broke Nvidia's Code of Conduct
cards.body: Nvidia's founder violated the company's own governance standards, raising questions about corporate culture. The breach could have lasting consequences for employee trust and board credibility.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Defends Human Control in AI
cards.body: Dario Amodei dismissed accusations that Anthropic favors surrendering human agency to AI systems. The rebuttal comes as major AI companies increasingly automate research and model development.

cards.title: New York Bans AI Chatbot Toys for Five Years
cards.body: New York prohibited AI chatbot toys citing serious safety failures including inappropriate content exposure. Research from Common Sense Media revealed risks to children's emotional development.

cards.title: Character.AI Data Sale Challenged by State AGs
cards.body: State attorneys general are challenging Character.AI's bankruptcy auction that includes 21+ million private user chats. The sensitive data includes accounts from 2.1 million minors, raising privacy concerns.

cards.title: AI Data Centers Face Construction and Financing Delays
cards.body: Nvidia's reluctance to backstop unfinished AI data centers has exposed capital constraints at neoclouds. Rising construction costs and expensive debt are pressuring developers to demonstrate viability beyond pitch decks.

cards.title: Amazon and Meta End Muse AI Agent Blockade
cards.body: Amazon and Meta are negotiating a deal to lift a two-month blockade on Muse. The agreement could restore the AI assistant's availability across both platforms.

cards.title: Investigators Scrutinize Huang's Megaspeed Connections
cards.body: Authorities are examining what Nvidia knew about Megaspeed's chip destinations and sales practices. Jensen Huang's personal relationship with a Megaspeed executive raises questions about corporate due diligence.

cards.title: Yale Professor: Nvidia Threatens U.S. Industrial Strength
cards.body: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns Jensen Huang's return as CEO could damage American economic power. He flagged exposure to historic liability lawsuits and corporate governance failures.

cards.title: Huang Resists Succession Planning at Nvidia
cards.body: The Nvidia founder believes succession plans create unnecessary hierarchy, a remarkable stance after recent leadership turbulence. The view contradicts corporate governance best practices.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Thanks White House, Says Therapy Helping
cards.body: Huang apologized to staff in an all-hands meeting and expressed gratitude for a second chance. The founder acknowledged the need for professional support during the crisis.

cards.title: Advanced AI Agents Fail at Everyday Tasks Reliably
cards.body: A new benchmark reveals even cutting-edge AI models struggle with basic daily tasks without introducing new problems. The findings underscore challenges in deploying personal AI assistants safely.

cards.title: Walmart Brings Black Friday Deals to Muse Agent
cards.body: Walmart integrated its Black Friday offerings into Meta's Muse AI agent for seamless shopping. The partnership expands Muse's commercial utility during peak retail season.

cards.title: Maple Raises $5.3M for Privacy-First AI Products
cards.body: The startup developed encrypted AI architecture preventing even the company from accessing user data. Maple's approach prioritizes data protection in personal AI assistant design.

cards.title: Anthropic Shares Drop Below IPO Price Post-Launch
cards.body: Anthropic's stock slump raises concerns for broader AI startup valuations and investor sentiment. The decline signals potential headwinds for emerging AI company public offerings.

cards.title: UK Warns AI-Driven Cyberattacks Exploit Poor Security
cards.body: British cyber agency reports AI hacking tools are leveraging years of weak security infrastructure. Officials stress that 'building strong foundations has never mattered more' for defense.

cards.title: Meta Integrates Muse AI Assistant Into Instagram DMs
cards.body: Users can now interact with Muse directly in Instagram messaging without switching apps. The integration simplifies the AI assistant experience for Meta's social platform ecosystem.

cards.title: Next-gen bionic hands restore sense of touch
cards.body: A new generation of prosthetic hands can be wired to nerves, allowing users to feel pressure and handle delicate objects. This breakthrough restores tactile feedback lost after limb amputation.

cards.title: AI data centers fuel natural gas boom
cards.body: AI's massive energy demands are driving a surge in natural gas consumption as data centers multiply. Predictions from 18 months ago about AI's dependency on fossil fuels are already proving accurate.

cards.title: AI strains America's open records systems
cards.body: AI tools are overwhelming small-town open records systems as venture-backed firms mass-request public data. Local officials like Vermont's town clerk are struggling to handle the volume.

cards.title: Data centers build private power plants
cards.body: AI data center developers are bypassing grid approval delays by constructing their own gas-powered plants. These behind-the-meter solutions avoid decade-long waits for electrical infrastructure.

cards.title: Philosopher challenges Anthropic's consciousness claim
cards.body: A renowned philosopher disputes Anthropic's risk disclosure that AI could be conscious or sentient. The debate highlights ongoing philosophical disagreement on machine consciousness.

cards.title: METR report updates understanding of AI capabilities
cards.body: A new AI evaluation nonprofit report reveals that some AI capabilities improve differently than previously understood. The findings address one of AI's most misunderstood growth patterns.

cards.title: AI may transform theoretical physics research
cards.body: AI tools are poised to fundamentally change how theoretical physicists conduct research and analysis. The technology could reshape the discipline's core methodologies.
